KIMBERLY-CLARK CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS—(Continued) As of December 31, 2010 and 2009, there were less than $1 million of assets in the Principal Plans with a
level 3 fair value determination (significant unobservable inputs). In addition, during 2010 and 2009, there were
no significant transfers of assets in the Principal Plans among level 1, 2 or 3 fair value determinations.

KMB_2010_p65__paragraph_1.ocr: We anticipate contributing between $400 million and $500 million to our pension plans in 2011.
